findings.message: 2 tl.fromTo() calls target "#phone-fade" with no stable baseline. The last-authored fromTo "from" values become the element's resting state for any seek before the first tween actually runs, because GSAP applies fromTo from-values at authoring time (immediateRender), not at tween position.
findings.fixHint: Add `immediateRender: false` to every fromTo except the earliest-positioned one (at 0s), so pre-first-tween seeks keep its "from" values. A hiding `tl.set(..., 0)` baseline trips gsap_timeline_set_initial_hide, and a `gsap.set` authored before the fromTo calls is overwritten by them.

findings.message: <video id="vid-video"> has data-start="0.5" inside a sub-composition. Nested media timing is local to its composition by default; a nonzero value can be confused with a legacy root-global timestamp.
findings.fixHint: Keep data-start="0.5" if it is composition-local. If this is a legacy root-global timestamp, add data-hf-media-start-basis="global"; otherwise convert it to local time by subtracting the host start.

findings.message: Frame 0 shows only the background, and the first frame is the thumbnail on social players: have the title or key image already on screen at 0 s instead of entering from nothing; see references/review.md.
Nothing on screen changes for 7.88 s (5.00–12.88 s): start the next move within 3 s, or put data-hold on the element whose stillness is deliberate; see references/motion.md.

Type floor is 28 px (2.6% of the 1080 px short side, what a phone can read) and 6 text elements stay under it for 0.5 s or more, the smallest "Nature Audio Tour" at 14 px: set reading text to at least 28 px, or put data-layout-ignore on text that is texture rather than reading; see references/look.md.
